info.title: Files Connect API
info.description:
API for file uploads, downloads, and processing.

## Authentication & Authorization

This API uses JWT Bearer token authentication with role-based access control (RBAC).

### User Roles

The following roles are defined in the system:

- **provider**: Can upload files, create processing jobs, and manage databanks. Full read/write access to their own databanks.
- **consumer**: Can view and download files from databanks they have access to. Read-only access.
- **cos_admin**: Administrative role with elevated privileges across the system.

### Access Control

Each API endpoint specifies which roles are allowed to access it. Check the endpoint description for the "Access Control" section to see which roles can use that endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: JWT-based authentication. The JWT token should contain user roles in the realm_access.roles claim. Supported roles: provider, consumer, cos_admin

get.description: Checks if the API is running properly

get.summary: Get the public key for client-side envelope encryption
get.description:
Returns the public half of the configured Cloud KMS asymmetric key. Clients use it to wrap a per-file AES-256 data encryption key before uploading encrypted data. The endpoint is available only when `ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true`.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

publicKeyPem.description: PEM-encoded RSA public key used to wrap the per-file AES-256 data encryption key

kmsKeyVersion.description: Cloud KMS key-version resource name used to unwrap the data encryption key

post.summary: List files in a databank directory
post.description:
Returns a list of files and directories in the specified databank directory.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`

recursive.description: When true, returns all files recursively including those in subdirectories

post.summary: Download a specific file from a databank
post.description:
Returns a specific file or generates a presigned URL for download.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`

presigned.description: Whether to return a presigned URL

post.summary: Get metadata for a specific file in a databank
post.description:
Returns metadata for a specific file in a databank.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: No authentication required (Public endpoint)

post.summary: Delete a specific file from a databank
post.description:
Deletes a specific file from a databank by key.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer` (owner only)

post.summary: Generate preview for a specific file in a databank
post.description:
Returns a preview of a specific file in a databank.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`

fileType.description: File type for preview; inferred from the key when omitted

content.description: Preview data; shape depends on the file format

400.description: Invalid request or file format not supported

post.summary: Initiate a multipart upload to a databank
post.description:
Initiates a multipart upload to a databank and returns presigned URLs for uploading parts. Supports approved databank formats, including CSV, JSON, TXT, Parquet, XLSX, NAV, OBS, BIN, and MRK. Executable files are not permitted.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

put.summary: Complete a multipart upload to a databank
put.description:
Finalizes a multipart upload to a databank.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

parts.description: Uploaded parts. Each item must provide PartNumber or partNumber and ETag or eTag.

post.description:
Cancels an in-progress multipart upload and removes any uploaded parts.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

Uploads an asset using multipart/form-data and returns a unique key for future reference. Only PDF and image files are allowed (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, TIFF, BMP).

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`, `cos_admin`

key.description: Unique key for the uploaded asset

post.summary: Get a presigned URL for an asset
post.description:
Returns a presigned URL for downloading an asset.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `cos_admin`

get.summary: Generate temporary credentials for databank access
get.description:
Returns AWS STS temporary credentials with limited permissions to the databank. Use these credentials for direct S3 access (e.g. DuckDB, Athena). Duration is configured via STS_SESSION_DURATION_IN_SECONDS.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`

Returns a presigned URL for downloading the databank zip file.

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`, `consumer`

get.summary: Get download URL for report PDF
get.description:
Returns a presigned URL for downloading the data readiness report PDF for a databank.

**Report Location:**
- Reports are stored at `reports/{databankId}/data_readiness_report.pdf` in `BUCKET_NAME`
- Reports are generated by the report worker after processing a report job
- The report contains comprehensive data quality assessment including metrics for quality, variance, standardization, documentation, etc.

**Access Control:**
- This endpoint is public and does not require authentication.

404.description: Report PDF not found (report may not have been generated yet)

post.summary: Create a processing job for a databank
post.description:
Creates a new processing job for a databank. Supports three job types:

**Job Types:**
- `zip`: Creates a compressed zip archive of the databank files (zip job only)
- `report`: Runs data readiness assessment on the databank, generating JSON and PDF reports (report job only)
- `all`: Runs both zip and report jobs; returns separate job IDs for each so you can poll status for each

**Zip Job Options:**
- `options.include`: Optional list of databank-relative file names/paths to include in the generated zip
- Omit `options.include` to zip all files in the databank

**Report Job Details:**
- Automatically detects structured (CSV, Parquet, JSON) or unstructured (PDF, Images, Audio, Excel, DICOM) datasets
- Runs comprehensive data quality assessment framework
- Generates detailed JSON reports and a visual PDF summary
- Uploads PDF report to `reports/{databankId}/data_readiness_report.pdf` in `BUCKET_NAME`
- Uses Redis job queue for asynchronous processing
- Job status can be queried via the job status endpoint

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

type.description: Type of processing job: zip (zip only), report (report only), or all (both zip and report)

include.description: Optional databank-relative file names/paths to include in the generated zip. Omit to zip all files.

202.description: Processing job(s) created and queued. For type zip or report, returns a single job. For type all, returns jobIds.zip and jobIds.report so you can poll each job separately.

status.description: Job status: pending, processing, completed, or failed

type.description: Job type: zip, report, or all

result.description: Job result data (varies by job type)

zip.description: Job ID for the zip job; poll GET .../process/{jobId} with this ID

report.description: Job ID for the report job; poll GET .../process/{jobId} with this ID

get.description:
Retrieves the current status of a processing job for a databank.

**Status Values:**
- `pending`: Job queued, waiting for worker
- `processing`: Worker is processing the job
- `completed`: Job completed successfully
- `failed`: Job failed with error

**Result Field (for completed report jobs):**
When a report job completes, the `result` field contains:
- `success`: Boolean indicating success
- `data_type`: Type of data processed (`structured` or `unstructured`)
- `files_processed`: Number of files processed
- `reports_uploaded`: Number of reports uploaded
- `processing_time_seconds`: Total processing time

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

status.description: Job status: pending, processing, completed, or failed

type.description: Job type: zip, report, or all

result.description: Job result data (varies by job type)

put.description:
Updates the status of a processing job for a databank.

**Note:** This endpoint is primarily used by worker processes to update job status during processing. The status is automatically updated by workers as jobs progress.

**Status Values:**
- `pending`: Job queued, waiting for worker
- `processing`: Worker is processing the job
- `completed`: Job completed successfully
- `failed`: Job failed with error

**Result Field (for report jobs):**
When a report job completes, the `result` field contains:
- `success`: Boolean indicating success
- `data_type`: Type of data processed (`structured` or `unstructured`)
- `files_processed`: Number of files processed
- `reports_uploaded`: Number of reports uploaded
- `processing_time_seconds`: Total processing time
- `download_time_seconds`: Time spent downloading files
- `framework_time_seconds`: Time spent running assessment framework
- `upload_time_seconds`: Time spent uploading reports

**Access Control:**
- Allowed Roles: `provider`

result.description: Result data (varies by job type; see description for report job structure)

status.description: Job status: pending, processing, completed, or failed

type.description: Job type: zip, report, or all

result.description: Job result data (varies by job type)
